span.p: NO — simple automation a maker could own

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Owned & maintained by a citizen maker in O365,
or by IT/dev in an Azure subscription?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Needs resource-level RBAC, audit trails,
VNet, or B2B/EDI?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Power Automate cloud flow
(per-user O365 license · DLP-governed · solution-aware ALM)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Cloud flow that CALLS a Logic App
(keep maker ownership, delegate the enterprise leg)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Azure Logic Apps
(re-platform — the requirement is enterprise-wide)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
High-volume / stateful enterprise orchestration,
B2B/EDI, VNet, or Azure-Policy-governed?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Azure Logic Apps
(Azure billing · Azure Policy + resource RBAC · Bicep/ADO ALM)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Reconsider a cloud flow
— don't pay the Azure-subscription tax for simple automation
